cohort: 60 women with postpartum psychosis within 4 weeks of delivery and 30 postpartum women without psychosis in Egypt
finding: Younger age, primiparity, low birth weight, cesarean delivery, a rapid drop in estrogen level, and thyroid dysfunction were associated with postpartum psychosis.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common among women with postpartum psychosis (58.3%).
gest_age: Premature delivery was higher among women with postpartum psychosis.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was more common among women with postpartum psychosis
